testset_note: MASTER file integrating ALL prior test sets (v2 baseline 9 real + 2 synthetic; A processed-blindspot; B incomplete-variants; C calorie-density; D moderation-perverse; E fruit-juice). Every user now carries user_profile demographics (age/sex/height/weight/PAL/goal) and moderation_estimates (sodium_mg, added_sugars_g, saturated_fat_g, fatty acids pufa/mufa/sfa). Each user has a testset_group field so groups stay separable. CONTROLLED GROUPS keep demographics and moderation identical within the group so the probed variable stays isolated -- EXCEPT group A, whose whole purpose is identical food groups but different hidden axes, so A1(clean) and A2(junk) intentionally differ in sodium/added-sugar/saturated-fat. This is INPUT data only; the calculator is unchanged and still excludes the moderation fields from scoring. HEI-2020 moderation standards for future use: sodium full<=1.1 zero>=2.0 g/1000kcal; added sugars full<=6.5% zero>=26% energy; saturated fat full<=8% zero>=16% energy; fatty acids ratio(P+M)/S full>=2.5 zero<=1.2.
